item.description:
[Grafen] Damask Rose Perfume Shampoo 500ml
★ ANTI-HAIR LOSS SHAMPOO WITH LUXURIOUS SCENT

[Key Features]
 · Anti-Hair Loss Shampoo with 24-Hour Lasting Luxurious Scent 
 ·  Paraben-free. Silicone-free, Synthetic Pigment-free and Sulfate-based Surfactants-free

 · Why it's special:
"   ✓ Carefully chosen natural ingredients under strict standards for anti-hair loss
     👉 Niacinamide, Salicylic Acid, Dexpanthenol and other ingredients for reducing hair loss
     👉 90% natural ingredients : Moisturizes and nourishes hair, hair root & scalp"
"   ✓ Elimited the toxics and fill with natural ingredients
    👉 Paraben-free. Silicone-free, Synthetic Pigment-free and Sulfate-based Surfactants-free"
"   ✓ 24-hour lasting scent
    👉 Conducted 81 fragrance tests
      👉 Damask rose oil lasts for a long period of time after shampooing, leaves a subdued fragrance"
 · Highly recommended for people who want&need:
   ✓ A safety confirmed shampoo with luxurious scent and anti-hair loss effect 
   ✓ To moiturize and nourish hair & scalp

[Ingredients]
Water, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate, Sodium Cocoyl Alaninate, Fragrance, Sodium Chloride, Cocamide MEA, Cocamide Methyl MEA, Sodium Benzoate, PEG-150 Distearate, Polyquaternium-10, Caprylyl Glycol, Salicylic Acid, Panthenol, Niacinamide, Citric Acid, Tetrasodium EDTA, Rosa Damascena Flower Wate(97 ppm)r, Butylene Glycol, Camellia Sinensis Leaf Extract, 1,2-Hexanediol, Linalool, Limonene, Hydroxycitronellal

[Volume]
500ml

[Country of Origin]
Republic of Korea 

[Expiry Date]
36 months from the manufacturing date

[Shipping]
From South Korea or local shipping

[Return/Refund Policy]
